title: Quiz: Structured Data
description: Check your understanding of Structured Data.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: What does structured data add to a page?
options: Machine-readable meaning that enables rich search results
questions.correctAnswer: Machine-readable meaning that enables rich search results
questions.explanation: It describes entities (products, articles) so engines can enhance listings.

questions.question: True or False: Structured data should describe only content visible on the page.
Fill in the blank: "@type": "${type}"   // e.g. Article, Product, FAQPage
In HTML, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
